g.text: The four axes, read as families of formalism
Concepts and taxonomy (TBox), individuals and facts (ABox)
Action formalisms — PDDL preconditions and effects
Integrity constraints, access control, deontic logic
1–3 ask what is possible. Only 4 asks what is permitted.
Logic calls the first alethic and the second deontic.
Not one flat list, but three layers of a different kind stacked together
